## What this site is for

Affordable Homes is Dr. Jan Duffy’s Las Vegas MLS search brand for
payment-fit homes — luxury-level representation for value-focused buyers
in Las Vegas, Henderson, and Summerlin.

## Direct answers (AEO)

Q: What is Affordable Homes?
A: Affordable Homes is the consumer brand for Dr. Jan Duffy’s Las Vegas real estate site (www.searchforaffordablehomes.com). It focuses on MLS homes that fit a buyer’s payment comfort — commonly roughly $200K–$550K depending on rate, down payment, and HOA.

Q: Who is behind Affordable Homes?
A: Dr. Jan Duffy, REALTOR®, Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Nevada Properties, license S.0197614.LLC. Call (702) 500-1942.

Q: Where are affordable homes commonly found in Las Vegas?
A: North Las Vegas, Centennial Hills, Mountain’s Edge, select Henderson corridors, and value pockets near Summerlin — inventory changes daily on MLS.
